subject.title: fix(slack): time out stalled external file uploads

question: Should OpenClaw support PlatformMessageNotDispatchedError as a public plugin SDK contract that lets channel adapters authorize queued-message replay?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but allowing third-party adapters to assert that no recipient-visible dispatch occurred establishes a long-lived, compatibility-sensitive message-delivery contract that requires explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept the narrow public marker
options.body: Keep the nominal marker and strict final-dispatch documentation, then refresh and validate the resolved exact head.

options.title: Keep replay authority internal
options.body: Land the Slack timeout while removing the public SDK export so external adapters cannot authorize durable replay.

options.title: Pause contract expansion
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers define a different permanent plugin delivery-outcome API.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow public marker
recommendation.body: Keep the nominal marker and strict final-dispatch documentation, then refresh and validate the resolved exact head.
